classes.description: A parser, candidate report, or incomplete observation is treated as authority that its admitted provenance cannot establish.

occurrences.evidence: The claimed literal rows are not authoritative:
The contention PASS oracle contradicts the authoritative ledger.
The generic nullable parser is otherwise explicitly non-authoritative;

codification.boundary: Authority depends on the public contract, admitted provenance, and producer for the reviewed surface, rather than a shared prose token.
codification.falsePositive: A lexical rule would reject correct warnings that explicitly say a surface is non-authoritative.
codification.falseNegative: The same defect can grant authority implicitly without using authority vocabulary, so a text rule would miss it.

classes.description: The proposed evidence remains green when the criterion's essential equality, ordering, or boundary is removed.

occurrences.evidence: OP-PT-011 several acceptance methods were non-discriminating
The required byte-equality deletion test is still not closed:
lower-priority values and cannot discriminate this defect
A checker-owned immutable manifest must anchor the complete expected class

codification.boundary: Discrimination requires comparing executable behavior after removing the specific criterion under review.
codification.falsePositive: Counting tests, mutants, or evidence labels would reject compact proofs whose single vector removes the governing equality.
codification.falseNegative: A large suite can contain the expected words while every assertion still survives deletion of the criterion.

classes.description: A failed-open prefix with missing required snapshot identity evidence is classified as UNSUPPORTED instead of UNKNOWN.

occurrences.evidence: The B1 finding class is filed into the ISS-046 census now

codification.nextEvidence: A second independently filed occurrence can continue this candidate; Decision #182 keeps the source parked at attempt 8 and admits no attempts 9 or 10 before its concrete gate.

classes.description: Acceptance or review evidence names a positive path but omits a concrete removal, substitution, refusal, or hostile-input control.

occurrences.evidence: OP-PT-011 several acceptance methods were non-discriminating
they contain no nonce-mismatch, malformed/multiple, overflow, timeout, or kill-refusal mutant
A structural negative control must traverse the called
The review-seed discriminator must reject negated verbs, negated or empty

classes.description: A packet adds a mechanism without a named consumer or retains work beyond the admitted threat and review boundary.

occurrences.evidence: delete from ISS-006; park with unpark condition at `ISS-019`
adds terminal capability machinery needed by neither named ISS-041 nor ISS-013 consumer
parked architecture sentence is not a current command.

codification.boundary: Scope is decided by the admitted threat, consuming dependency, and smallest credible alternative for the specific packet.
codification.falsePositive: A path or heading rule would reject necessary cross-layer contract changes that are named by an actual consumer.
codification.falseNegative: An unnecessary mechanism can stay inside predicted files and use complete In and Out headings while still widening scope.
